**About The Job**
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 The Access Transparency (AXT) team is foundational to customer trust in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), ensuring every administrative access to user content is justified, transparent, and compliant with critical global standards. Within AXT, our team operates at the intersection of AI compliance and site reliability. We lead initiatives to eliminate operational risks by building self\-healing automation and advanced telemetry that prevent unsafe manual interventions in production. We also build the foundational infrastructure that ensures autonomous AI workflows and agents remain verifiable, transparent, and compliant with strict regulatory standards. Joining this team means handling high\-impact, distributed systems challenges that define how both human engineers and AI agents safely operate across Google Cloud.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Software Engineer III – Agentic Acceleration Group**
 We are looking for a Software Engineer III to join our Agentic Acceleration Group and help build and scale agentic AI capabilities on Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK) and other enterprise agentic platforms. This role provides an opportunity to contribute to cutting\-edge agentic AI systems, intelligent automation workflows, and impactful software solutions used by enterprises and users worldwide. As a Software Engineer III, you will own the development of agent\-powered features and projects, contribute to technical design decisions, and help establish modern agent development practices. You will be responsible for the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of complex agentic systems built on established AI platforms, working collaboratively with product, architecture, and engineering partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Agent Development: Design, build, test, and deploy production\-grade AI agents using Google ADK and other agentic platforms such as the Anthropic Claude SDK and LangGraph. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code for agent workflows, tool integrations, and multi\-agent orchestration.
* Platform Integration: Build agents that integrate with enterprise systems through tools, APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Implement custom tools, skills, and plugins that extend agent capabilities across UKG’s HCM platform.
* Feature and Project Delivery: Own execution and delivery of agent\-powered features and projects, working with product management and engineering partners to clarify requirements, manage priorities and timelines, and deliver high\-quality results.
* Technical Design: Participate in design reviews with peers, architects, and stakeholders. Contribute to the design of complex agentic systems and applications, including multi\-agent coordination patterns, task delegation workflows, and agent communication protocols, with attention to performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Code Review and Engineering Practices: Review code developed by other engineers, provide constructive feedback, and help maintain a high bar for technical excellence, including clean coding practices, appropriate design patterns, unit testing, and observability built from the ground up.
* Service Health and Quality: Maintain the health and quality of agent\-powered services by proactively identifying and addressing issues. Use service health indicators, agent performance metrics such as task success rates, latency, and cost, and telemetry to recommend improvements. Conduct root cause analysis for agent failures and help implement measures to prevent recurrence.
* Agent Operations: Support agent deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Apply practices for agent versioning, cost monitoring, performance optimization, and iterative improvement. Build observability into agent workflows, including execution tracing, decision logging, and failure analysis.
* Testing and Evaluation: Build testable agents and agentic systems; define and automate tests using appropriate frameworks. Apply agent\-specific testing strategies, including prompt validation, agent evaluation, multi\-step workflow testing, tool invocation testing, tool validation, and adversarial scenario testing.
* DevOps Model: Take ownership across the software lifecycle—from collaborating with product management on requirements through design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of software in production.
* Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Document new features, enhancements, fixes, agent behaviors, and operational procedures. Share knowledge with teammates and contribute to training materials and team practices.
* Mentorship and Collaboration: Collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams and provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers on agent development, tool integrations, testing, observability, and agent safety practices.
* Innovation: Stay current with emerging agentic AI technologies and platforms—including Google ADK, Anthropic Claude SDK, LangGraph, AutoGen, and CrewAI—and evaluate or adopt new capabilities, integrations, and orchestration patterns where they improve productivity, quality, or customer value.


**Qualifications**
